about: Endings that make another form of the same word, for the rule of two informative words: 'аренда' and 'аренду' count once, 'квартира' and 'квартирант' twice. Both words must have endings of one language. Kazakh suffixes come from kazakh_suffix_pattern of lexicon.json. short is for words with two shared letters ('еда', 'еду'), verb and kazakh_verb for words with four or more ('подарил', 'подарить'; 'жалдады', 'жалдайды').
